request.prompt: Tension layer for a stealth game, meant to play underneath other music. 96 BPM, D minor, 4/4, 8 bars, steady tempo. Only two things: a tight, quiet sixteenth-note closed hi-hat pattern, and sustained tremolo strings holding a dark D minor drone with a slow creeping rise over the 8 bars and back down. No melody, no bass, no kick drum, no other instruments. Nervous and suspicious. No intro, no ending: it must loop seamlessly.
